deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds a causal link ('because') stating that benign tumours are extremely common because it takes a great deal for them to become malignant. The text states both facts but does not state that one is the cause of the other.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So benign tumors are actually incredibly common. Right? So it actually takes a lot for a benign tumor to become malignant
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Benign tumours are extremely common, because it takes a great deal for a benign tumour to become malignant

considerations.reason: The rewrite states that incidence describes how often tumours arise. This is an allowed clarification of the apposition used in the text.
